description: Pick raffle winners fairly with a Fisher-Yates shuffle — set the winner count, reveal them one by one, and export the results.

faqs.a: Every entry is shuffled with the Fisher-Yates algorithm, then winners are taken from the top — each entry has an equal chance.
Yes — each entry can win only once; winners are removed from the pool before the next pick.
Winners are highlighted in the draw order; remaining entries stay listed so you can audit the draw.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Set how many winners to draw.
Press Draw winners and reveal them, then download the results.
title: Raffle Picker
